description: Page through the attendees of one agenda session. Returns only the attendee list with a cursor, not the session details; use get_session for those. Provide session_id or path (from get_agenda).

after.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

path.description: Session URL path from get_agenda; alternative to session_id.

session_id.description: Session id from get_agenda. Optional when path is set.

name: list_session_attendees
title: List B2match session attendees
